title: Capability and parity inventory
objective: Before any MCP widening, map every intended Desktop Commander-class workstation and development workflow and every implemented Cotra provider capability to exactly one of implemented and exposed, implemented and hidden, missing, or intentionally denied, with the grain that owns each change, and pin the inventory against the authoritative tool catalog and the cotrad capability set in contract tests.

include: a machine-readable inventory of intended workflows and implemented capabilities with one of four statuses, the owning successor grain, and the security reason for every denial
a human-readable parity document derived from the same inventory

contract tests proving every exposed entry matches the authoritative MCP catalog, every implemented capability shape appears exactly once, every denied entry names its reason, and no entry is unclassified
exclude: any MCP tool, schema, capability, approval, or authority change
any executable registry, filesystem mutation, browser, desktop, clipboard, or network exposure (SG-000060 through SG-000064)

invariants: no MCP widening before the inventory is canonical
intentionally denied authority is a documented security decision
the authoritative catalog stays unchanged in this grain

acceptance.claim: Every intended workflow and implemented capability is classified exactly once with an owning grain or a denial reason.
Contract tests pin the inventory to the authoritative MCP catalog and the cotrad capability set with no unclassified entry.
Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of excluded files, and zero unresolved review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000060: The protected executable registry may proceed only after SG-000059 closes with the inventory canonical.

done_when: The capability and parity inventory is canonical and pinned by contract tests before any P16 widening.

canonical_evidence.jev: PASSED: genuine TypeSafe Jev exact-diff review covered 4/4 hunks with zero findings and zero blocking findings, pin 31f89602797fb7bea007f8a480bf368bf564954e
canonical_evidence.ocr: PASSED: Alibaba Open Code Review v1.12.9 exact-range delegation over 4 changed files, 2 reviewable (docs/p16/capability_parity_inventory.json and scripts/generate-parity-doc.mjs) with delegated rules applied and 2 excluded (apps/cotra-mcp/src/parity-inventory.test.ts by default-path classification and docs/p16/CAPABILITY_PARITY.md by unsupported-extension classification) manually reviewed
canonical_evidence.security_review: PASS on exact qualified head: machine-readable inventory classifying 60 capability shapes (20 exposed equal to the authoritative catalog, 29 implemented and hidden with owning grains SG-000062 through SG-000064, 10 local authority management shapes intentionally denied with reasons) and 35 workflows (10 exposed, 6 hidden, 8 missing with owning grains SG-000060 and SG-000061 or outside the v0.2 target, 11 intentionally denied with security reasons including shell strings, PowerShell and cmd, interactive interpreters, background processes, arbitrary process termination, elevation, outside-workspace reads, raw sockets, browser scripting, agent self-policy, and installers); generated human-readable document; contract tests pinning exposed entries to the catalog, scope matrix, and the capability each tool sends, proving hidden and denied shapes exist in cotrad sources and are not MCP tools, and requiring owners and reasons. No MCP, schema, capability, or approval change. All closed SG-000001 through SG-000058 regressions pass. Qodo billing-blocked and CodeRabbit skipped-review notices evaluated as non-evidence noise with zero substantive findings; zero unresolved threads.
canonical_evidence.authority_boundary: Inventory, generated parity document, generator script, and contract tests only. No MCP tool, schema, capability, approval, or provider change.
